## Education

```{python}
#| output: asis
from _helpers import load
edu = load("education")
for e in edu:
    line = f"**{e['degree']}**"
    if e.get("field"):
        line += f", {e['field']}"
    line += f" — {e['institution']}, {e.get('location','')} ({e['years']})"
    if e.get("thesis"):
        line += f". Thesis: *{e['thesis']['title']}*; advisor {e['thesis']['advisor']}"
    print(f"- {line}")
```

## Industry Experience

## Grants & Fellowships

```{python}
#| output: asis
from _helpers import load
g = load("grants")
for item in g["shown_on_website"]:
    label = item["name"]
    yrs = ""
    if item.get("start"):
        yrs = f"{item['start']}–{item.get('end') or 'present'}"
    elif item.get("year"):
        yrs = str(item["year"])
    extra = ""
    if item.get("amount_gbp"):
        extra = f" · £{item['amount_gbp']:,}"
    role = ""
    if item.get("role"):
        role = f" · {item['role']}"
    print(f"- **{yrs}** — {label}{role}{extra}")
```

## Service

```{python}
#| output: asis
from _helpers import load
s = load("service")

if s.get("editorial"):
    print("\n### Editorial\n")
    for e in s["editorial"]:
        print(f"- **{e['start']}–{e['end']}** — {e['role']}, *{e['journal']}*")

if s.get("program_committees"):
    print("\n### Program Committees & Reviewing\n")
    for c in s["program_committees"]:
        bits = [c["committee"], c.get("role", "")]
        if c.get("note"):
            bits.append(c["note"])
        if c.get("start"):
            yrs = f"{c['start']}–{c.get('end') or 'present'}"
            bits.append(yrs)
        print("- " + " — ".join(b for b in bits if b))

if s.get("peer_review"):
    print("\n### Peer Review Panels\n")
    for r in s["peer_review"]:
        if r.get("year"):
            yrs = str(r["year"])
        else:
            yrs = f"{r['start']}–{r.get('end') or 'present'}"
        print(f"- **{yrs}** — {r['name']}")

if s.get("keynotes"):
    print("\n### Keynote Speeches\n")
    for k in s["keynotes"]:
        print(f"- **{k['date']}** — *{k['title']}* — {k['venue']}")
```

## PhD Students

```{python}
#| output: asis
from _helpers import load
st = load("students")

print("\n### Current Advisees\n")
for s in st["current_advisees"]:
    line = f"- **{s['name']}** ({s['institution']}, {s['field']}, since {s['start']}) — {s.get('role','')}"
    if s.get("note"):
        line += f". {s['note']}"
    print(line)

print("\n### Past Advisees\n")
for s in st["past_advisees"]:
    when = s.get("graduated") or s.get("years")
    line = f"- **{s['name']}** ({s['institution']}, {s['field']}, {when}) — {s.get('role','')}"
    if s.get("placement"):
        line += f". Now: {s['placement']}"
    print(line)

if st.get("notable_committee_roles"):
    print("\n### Notable Committee Roles\n")
    for s in st["notable_committee_roles"]:
        when = s.get("graduated")
        line = f"- **{s['name']}** ({s['institution']}, {s['field']}, {when}) — {s.get('role','')}"
        if s.get("placement"):
            line += f". Now: {s['placement']}"
        print(line)
```
